description: Declarative photo-derived texture specification for Nana Plaza (Sukhumvit Soi 4, Bangkok). Every non-placeholder texture is cropped, perspective-rectified, seam-tiled (where applicable), and resized to power-of-two dimensions from extracted gallery photos.
